notes.note: Reviewed against this branch's change: apply-android-native-bootstrap.mjs now keeps the onCreate hook and inset bridge, strips the legacy Keyring.initializeNdkContext call and bridge, and refuses any other ndk_context initializer (tao 0.37 ndk_glue initializes it; ndk-context 0.1.1 asserts once). build-android.yml now runs reset-android-generated-project.mjs before init. This guide makes no Android pipeline or activity claims; the dependency is transitive through shared build owners. No prose change.
